scenes.heading: Choose a niche people can picture and refer

sents.d: Choose a niche people can picture and refer
If people can't picture who you help, they can't hire you or refer you. A clear niche fixes that.

scenes.heading: Vague titles are hard to refer

sents.d: Life coach or business consultant tells people almost nothing.
A friend who wants to recommend you can't think of the right person, so they don't.

scenes.heading: Who you help, plus the result

sents.d: A good niche names a specific person and a specific outcome.
Helping first-time managers get through their first year leading a team is far easier to remember than leadership coaching.
Write one line that says, I help this person get this result.
Read it to a few people and ask who comes to mind. If they name someone, you're close.
Many coaches narrow or shift their focus once they see who they enjoy working with and where they get the best results.

take: A niche is who you help plus the result you help them reach.
